endCondition.description: A player with 10 or more victory points on their own turn wins immediately.

notes: family: running-track-race. Winner is the first player to reach 10 VP during their own turn, not the highest at a fixed end, so only one player normally reaches 10; the form records final totals. Rulebook gives no tiebreaker (the first player to reach 10 on their turn wins). 5-6 player extension and scenarios/expansions not modelled.
